# Code of Conduct

**<PROJECT_NAME>** adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct. The canonical text is maintained at that URL; maintainers agree to enforce it as written.

## Reporting

Concerns may be reported privately to **<CONTACT_EMAIL>**. Reports are read by the project maintainers and treated confidentially.
